dsp_request.statement: lemma parallelogram: "ip (u +V v) (u +V v) +R ip (u -V v) (u -V v) = ((ip u u +R ip v u) +R (ip u v +R ip v v)) +R ((ip u u +R opp_R (ip v u)) +R (opp_R (ip u v) +R ip v v))"
